description.name: Estúdio Graça
description.headline: Compact studio with a balcony
description.description: A studio for two with a small balcony. The bed is a sofa bed. Tiled floors throughout.

reviews: Small but well organised. The sofa bed is firmer than we expected, in a good way.
Tram stop is close and the balcony gets afternoon sun.

policies.damage_deposit: 150 EUR, refundable within 7 days of checkout.
